scope: Read-only official ACHS route investigation; no parser, queue, source health, workflow or commit changed by this subtask.

reference_window.rule: Ages <=90 days; publication date must be verified per detail, not event/data period or a listing's modification field.

validated_surfaces.date_scheme: DD/MM/YYYY standalone below article H1; listing date is associated with each card.

validated_surfaces.result: Official Salud y Bienestar archive available; browser renders paging controls Anterior/Siguiente and 1/10 plus inline item payloads.
validated_surfaces.ordinary_article_href_warning: Rendered archive exposes literal detail paths in item payloads, while visible Leer artículo may resolve to a generic/no-specific target; inspect raw markup/JS before implementing discovery.
validated_surfaces.date_warning: Multiple timestamps occur per item; field semantics are not exposed by this browser.

verified_detail_examples.reason: Article identifies Clínicas Achs Salud subsidiary and Clínica Atacama as participants in SAFED. The beginning of service August19 is an event date, not the publication date.
Changes concern Centro Linares, Centro San Javier and Centro La Florida; Clínica Lircay appears as an out-of-hours referral. Do not assign the Centers expansion to the clinic subsidiary.
Guide for treatment of occupational mental-health conditions; 2024 research call in body is not publication date.
Occupational commuting accidents. First-semester data period is not publication date.
New preventive operational module; found on archive page2 inside the 90-day window.

newsroom.strategy: Fetch canonical first page, then /2, /3 etc. Deduplicate /1 against canonical, and details by canonical URL.
newsroom.next_stop_rule: Stop only after a fully captured page contains no date in window and ordering is verified; retain date/detail failures as unverified.
newsroom.caveat: Browser rendered markup lacks explicit paging-link destinations; URL segment scheme is verified by distinct live page responses. Raw HTML/server status remains for Actions.

observations: Inline media URLs use /images/librariesprovider17/... and sfvrsn query strings.
Date triplets and YYYYMMDDHHMMSS values occur with each literal /blog/detalle/ path.
provider_blog.cms_inference: These are Sitefinity-style signatures; CMS/API contract and JS network requests have not been captured, so no API endpoint is claimed verified.

date_trap.reason: Detail contains no visible publication date; first timestamp may be migration/modification. Do not promote old content as a 2026 publication.

recent_item.reason: Current item path is real, but rendered detail has no standalone date and archive has several unlabeled timestamps. Requires raw metadata/schema verification; health education alone is not a market-change signal.

separation_rules: Use article actors/content, not host-wide branding, navigation, footer or the common SUSESO footer.
Achs Salud includes clinics, Hospital del Trabajador and ambulatory Centers; do not collapse all three into Clínicas Achs Salud.
Clinic subsidiary attribution requires the subsidiary or a participating clinic as actor in the specific story.
Occupational insurance, prevention, commuting accidents and occupational-health tools belong to Achs Seguro Laboral; provider articles may share the same newsroom.
Undated identity pages and differing old/current clinic counts do not establish a dated expansion signal.

numeric_route_trap.result: Direct independent browser open returns a newsroom listing despite the noticia path; H1 is Centro de Noticias and cards contain multiple publication dates.
numeric_route_trap.recommendation: Keep canonical year/slug detail pattern and verify H1/article-bound date; reject numeric pseudo-detail listings.

candidate_probe_interpretation: Browser tool says inaccessible without origin status. This neither proves nonexistent endpoints nor confirms their availability.

Read-only subtask does not modify health/pending/feed and does not establish full source operational status.
next_action: Actions runner: preserve verified TLS, redirects/status/headers, raw HTML/XML hashes. Confirm archive paging and own-detail dates; inspect blog item field names and page JS/API requests, and parse RSS pubDate/entries before registering any alternative discovery route.
